page.layout: One printed page, right-hand part of an opening: running head at top centre with page number at top right; main text column with a numbered table (two rows of numbers, a rule, and a column of sums with a vertical bar) in the middle of the column; a note column at the left edge of the scan, partly cut off, with marginal text. This part ends mid-page, so no catchword or signature.; One printed page, text block in the centre-right; a fragment of a margin note column at the far left edge, outside the text block. Top: a line "FINIS" with a flourish, then a heading "APPEN-" set in capitals.

main_text.p: nundedit. Verùm hac contractus lege ad calculum re- uocata, immensus tritici numerus inuentus est, quem ne uniuersæ quidem domus Basilienses in granaria uersæ capere potuissent. Exemplum adjicere placuit. Inuenia- tur compendio sexagesimus progressionis terminus:
qui numerus tantus est, ut Adriatici maris arenam quasi adæquare posse uideatur.
main_text.head: APPEN-

page.notes: Left margin note column is cut off at the scan edge; its partial words (e.g. "endum", "itus uls", "s 1, res", "inde ex", "quar", "ntibus:", "sionis", "ndo &", "e latere") are margin text and are not transcribed here. The table's vertical bar and rule are as printed; the row of sums is set in a table, and the exact digit placement is approximate. The left-margin notes are cut off at the edge of the scan and only fragments remain: "modum", "incres", "ula ues", "nunc", written here as read. The top of the text block shows faint show-through from the other side of the leaf and is not transcribed. The heading "APPEN-" ends with a hyphen and continues on the following page, which is not on this scan.
